title: EUR rates: Take profit on 2y30y straddle

classification.rationale: The note closes a EUR 2y30y swaption straddle (long-end volatility) trade for profit, driven by repricing of front-end rate vol and central bank hiking expectations amid energy price concerns.
classification.runner_up_reason: The trade is an options position on EUR swap rates, so it could sit under swaps/vol, but the taxonomy has no rates-vol bucket and the note is a trade structure call on curve vol.

entities.name: Re-entering steepener and buying long-end volatility
